name: Volume Graphics
definition: An approach concerned with the synthesis, manipulation, and rendering of volumetric geometric objects, where geometric models are voxelized (3D scan-converted) into a set of voxels stored in a volume buffer with pre-computed view-independent attributes.
summary: Volume Graphics renders modeled geometric scenes by voxelizing them into a regular 3D buffer, offering viewpoint-independent rendering insensitive to scene complexity.
